title: RunResult
description: Tracto Common Execution Contract v1.0.1 — terminal result envelope emitted by the worker when a run attempt completes.

runId.description: Stable identifier for the run (shared across all attempts).

attemptId.description: Identifier unique to this attempt of the run.

leaseId.description: Lease token that was held during this attempt.

workerId.description: Stable identity of the worker that executed this attempt.

runState.description: Terminal run state. Only terminal states are valid in a run result (see C3 decision).

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the attempt began executing.

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the attempt reached a terminal state.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the attempt in milliseconds (monotonic timing per REF-10).

lastHeartbeatAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last heartbeat emitted by the worker, or null if none was sent.

stepResults.description: Ordered list of step results produced during this attempt.

errorCategory.description: Top-level error category for the run, populated when runState is FAILED, TIMED_OUT or UNKNOWN.

errorDetail.description: Stable dot-separated detail code qualifying errorCategory (e.g. action.commitUncertain).

needsAttention.description: True when the run terminated in UNKNOWN, or when a FAILED run requires operator review (see C3 decision, REF-06). Must be true whenever runState=UNKNOWN.

unknownReason.description: Stable string describing what could not be confirmed. Required when runState=UNKNOWN (see C3 decision).

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence records attached to this run.

continuationTriggered.description: True when a static continuation rule fired and a successor run was enqueued. Must not be true for HANDED_OFF, FAILED, UNKNOWN or CANCELLED without an explicit continuation rule (see REF-04).

StepResult.title: StepResult
StepResult.description: Result record for a single step executed during the attempt.

stepId.description: Identifier of the step as declared in the automation script.

stepState.description: Terminal or intermediate state of this step (see C3 decision for TIMED_OUT vs UNKNOWN vs FAILED semantics).

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the step began executing.

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the step reached a terminal state.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the step in milliseconds (monotonic timing per REF-10).

outputs.description: Key-value map of named outputs produced by the step. Keys are output field names declared in the script.

errorCategory.description: Error category for this step, populated when stepState is FAILED, TIMED_OUT or UNKNOWN.

errorDetail.description: Stable dot-separated detail code qualifying errorCategory (e.g. action.commitUncertain, precondition.waitTimeout).

needsAttention.description: True when this step reached UNKNOWN or when a FAILED step requires operator review (see C3 decision).

unknownReason.description: Stable string describing what could not be confirmed. Populated when stepState=UNKNOWN.

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: Reference to an evidence record associated with the run or a specific step.

evidenceRef.description: Opaque reference handle to the stored evidence artifact.

classification.description: Evidence classification indicating the nature and handling requirements of the evidence.

stepId.description: Step this evidence is scoped to, or null if the evidence is run-level.
